AeroPress Coffee Maker - Original
Original 3 in 1 Coffee Press
A new standard in coffee flavor.
Our unique 3 in 1 brew method speeds up extraction for less bitterness and a smoother, more full bodied cup.
Free shipping over $55
Easy Returns
For Home or Office
2-Minute Brew & Clean
1-2 Cups Capacity
1 Year Limited Warranty
The AeroPress Coffee Maker that started it all.
AeroPress Original was the first single cup coffee maker to combine 3 brew methods in one compact, portable device for a faster brew and better extraction.
A smooth, rich cup bursting with coffee bean flavor—without the bitterness or acidity found in other methods.
Part French press, part pour-over, part espresso—our award-winning 3-in-1 brew tech delivers unbeatable flavor (and clean up) in less than 2 minutes - wherever you brew.
Full bodied like a French press
Smooth like a Pour-Over
Rich like Espresso
Loved worldwide for our signature brew and endless espresso-style recipes and boasting over 75,000 five-star reviews in more than 70 countries, AeroPress just might make the best cup of coffee you'll ever taste.
Press for Better Coffee - in 2 minutes
3 in 1 Flavor Tech: fast immersion, micro-filtration, air pressure
Fast Immersion: minimizes bitterness, acidity and over-extraction
Air Pressure: for smooth, full-bodied coffee bean flavor
Micro-filtration: for zero grit
Travel-ready design: compact, lightweight, durable
Creative brews: from signature to espresso-style to cold brew to iced coffee
Brew and clean in 2 minutes
Dishwasher Safe (top rack only)
Capacity: 10 oz (1-2 cups)
Dimensions: 5.25" H x 4.2" W
1 year warranty
What’s Included
One Brewer to Rule Them All
If You Like French Press, You’ll Love AeroPress
Better flavor, more portable and faster and easier to use than other brew methods — AeroPress is loved around the world wit 75,000+ five star reviews in over 70 countries.
Let Your Beans Shine
Smooth, Full-bodied Coffee Bean Flavor
With less bitterness than other methods, you can finally enjoy the full spectrum of coffee, from tasting notes to level of roast to country of origin​.
The Secret to Our Superior Brew
3 in 1 Flavor Technology
Part French Press, part Pour-Over, part Espresso, AeroPress combines all three and uses air pressure and micro-filtration to brew faster so coffee doesn't over-extract, giving you a well‑balanced cup with bold flavor and zero grit.
Your Coffee Adventure Awaits ​
Built for Travel
​​​Compact, lightweight and shatterproof so you can make exceptional coffee on the road, at the office or wherever your brew takes you.
Just Press, for Better Coffee
Brew & Clean in Less Than 2 Minutes
Pour water, press your coffee, pop out the grinds and rinse!
Unleash Your Inner Barista​
Customize Your Brew​
Make your favorites faster - from our signature brew to cold brew to espresso-style to lattes.
Home or Office
Polypropylene
5.25" H x 4.2" W
Paper Micro-Filters
How much coffee does the AeroPress Original make?
The AeroPress Original can brew up to three shots of espresso style coffee.
If you prefer to brew your coffee by pushing all the water through the grounds, you can brew one 10 oz.
serving of coffee or cold brew.
What size filter do I use with the AeroPress Original?
You should use a Standard size filter with the AeroPress Original.
What kinds of coffee can the AeroPress Original make?
The AeroPress Original can make American style coffee, cold brew style coffee, or espresso style coffee for use in drinks like lattes and cappuccinos.
What are the maximum and minimum mug diameters the AeroPress Original fits?
The biggest mug you can press into with the AeroPress Original has a top inner diameter of 3 3/4 inches (95mm).
The smallest mug you can press into with the AeroPress Original has a top inner diameter of 2 5/8 inches (67mm).
Can I clean the AeroPress Original in the dishwasher?
You can in the top shelf, but a simple rinse is sufficient because the plunger wipes the chamber.
If your chamber ever gets sticky, wash it with vinegar.
We recommend occasionally removing the seal from the end of the plunger for a good washing inside and out with warm water and dish soap.
Where is AeroPress Original manufactured?
AeroPress Original is manufactured in the USA.
AeroPress was founded by inventor Alan Adler, who created the very first prototype in his garage in Palo Alto, California.
All AeroPress products continue to be conceived and designed in the USA.
What grind size should I use?
For the best brewing experience, use a medium-fine grind size, shake to level the bed of coffee grounds before pouring in the water, and pour the water slowly.
How do I clean and store AeroPress coffee makers?
Storage and Care:
To maximize the food-grade silicone seal's life, always eject the used coffee right after brewing and store your AeroPress coffee maker with the seal pushed all the way through the chamber.
This keeps the seal free of compression for longer seal life.
For day to day use, a simple rinse is sufficient because the plunger wipes the chamber clean as you brew.
What are the dimensions?
Plunger with Seal: 5.26" tall, 3.28" diameter; Chamber: 4.75" tall, 4.22" diameter (at widest part of the hexagon); Compressed Plunger + Chamber: 5.26" tall (height of the Plunger), 4.22" diameter (diameter of Chamber).
How much does the AeroPress Original weigh?
The weight of the AeroPress Original (including the chamber and plunger, the filter cap, the scoop, and the stirrer) is 7.75 ounces.
When camping, backpacking or traveling light, the parts of the AeroPress Original you would take along (the chamber, the plunger, the filter cap, and however many paper microfilters you thought you’d need) weigh 6.5 ounces.
You would leave the AeroPress scoop and stirrer at home, and use whatever spoon you were already bringing on your hike as a scoop and stirrer.
You should use a sturdy mug or carafe and should never press into a thin walled glass mug or carafe.
Inverted method:
The “inverted method” can cause the coffee maker to be less stable and prone to mishaps that expose the user to potential burns from hot liquid.
Be advised that we strongly discourage using the inverted method because it is less stable and therefore prone to tipping over and exposing the user to hot liquid.
A:Thank you for your question.
The biggest mug you can press into with the AeroPress Original has a top inner diameter of 3.75 inches (95mm).
The smallest mug you can press into with the AeroPress Original has a top inner diameter of 2.75 inches (70mm).
We hope that this helps.
Best wishes, Constance, AeroPress, Inc.
A:Thank you for your question!
The AeroPress Original can brew one 10 oz serving of American style coffee if you fill it all the way up to the top with water.
Yes, the AeroPress Original coffee maker is dishwasher safe (top rack only).
We have a great guide on how to make cold brew with your AeroPress coffee maker here: https://aeropress.com/pages/cold-brew.
The key is to stir briskly for one minute, which results in a lot of interaction between the ground coffee and the water to make up for the cooler temperature and the shorter time period.
The AeroPress Original makes an espresso style concentrate (follow instructions for espresso style here: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0601/8783/6659/files/AeroPress\Original\instructions\April\2023-English.pdf?v=1682705137).
Looking for a coffee maker that delivers rich, smooth, and flavorful coffee in under one minute?
Look no further than the AeroPress Original!
With patented brewing technology that's loved by coffee enthusiasts worldwide, this compact and easy-to-use device can produce cold brew, espresso style, and more.
Made in the USA from high-quality materials, the AeroPress Original is built to last and perfect for coffee lovers on the go.
Say goodbye to your French press and hello to the best coffee of your life.
Order your AeroPress Original today!

What is Hypervolt used for?
Hypervolt is used for various purposes, including sports recovery, pain management, stress reduction, and general wellness.

The light ring on the Hypervolt indicates the device's battery level and operational status.

Massage guns like the Hypervolt are generally suitable for various body types and fitness levels.

Proper use of massage guns typically results in minimal side effects.
However, excessive pressure or overuse can lead to muscle soreness or bruising.
It's important to use the device according to instructions and avoid using it on injured areas, bony areas, or near sensitive organs.
What are some recommended techniques for using a massage gun effectively?
For effective use, start with a low-intensity setting and gently move the massage gun across the muscle groups.
Avoid excessive pressure and focus on sore or tight areas.
Vary the attachments for different muscle areas and use consistent, smooth movements for best results.
Avoid bony areas and joints.

Better than ever

Whisper quiet

Recovery on demand
It's easy to find the warm-up and recovery plans that will help you feel and move better with step-by-step expert guidance through the Bluetooth® connected Hyperice App.
Everyday relaxation
The Hypervolt 2 delivers powerful, quiet percussion therapy that helps relieve everyday aches and muscle tension — whether you’re loosening up after a long day at your desk, recovering from a workout, or easing general stiffness so you can keep moving comfortably.
Frequently asked questions
What is Hypervolt used for?
Hypervolt is used for various purposes, including sports recovery, pain management, stress reduction, and general wellness.
It's an ideal tool for athletes, fitness enthusiasts, or anyone looking to enhance their overall muscular health.
Can you bring your Hypervolt on a plane?
All Hypervolt massage guns are suitable for air travel as they are TSA friendly for carry-on.
It's important to store it in your carry-on luggage due to its lithium-ion battery, which cannot be taken in checked-in baggage.
How to connect your Hypervolt to Bluetooth®?
To connect the Hypervolt to Bluetooth®, ensure your Hypervolt is on.
Open the Hyperice App and follow the prompts to locate and select your device.
The Hyperice App will guide you through the pairing process, allowing you to control the Hypervolt and access customized routines.
How to charge your Hypervolt?
To charge the Hypervolt, connect the provided charger to the port on the device.
Plug the charger into an electrical outlet.
Charging is indicated by the lights on the device, and it's best to charge it until all lights are lit, signifying a full charge.
What does the light ring on the Hypervolt mean?
The light ring on the Hypervolt indicates the device's battery level and operational status.
If your light ring is green, it has optimal charge.
As your Hypervolt loses charge, it will change from yellow to red.
Once fully charged, your Hypervolt light ring will turn solid green.
What does the Bluetooth® connection for the Hypervolt do?
The Bluetooth® feature on the Hypervolt allows it to connect to the Hyperice App.
This connectivity offers personalized massage programs, control over the device's speed settings, and the ability to track and tailor your recovery and massage routines for optimal results.
You can also connect your Hyperice App to Apple Health, Whoop, Strava, and Garmin so that your recovery routines are tailored to your activity levels.
Are massage guns suitable for all body types and fitness levels?
Massage guns like the Hypervolt are generally suitable for various body types and fitness levels.
They are versatile tools designed for use by athletes, fitness enthusiasts, or anyone seeking muscle relief.
However, individuals with certain medical conditions or sensitivities should consult a healthcare professional before use.
What are some potential side effects of using a massage gun?
Proper use of massage guns typically results in minimal side effects.
However, excessive pressure or overuse can lead to muscle soreness or bruising.
It's important to use the device according to instructions and avoid using it on injured areas, bony areas, or near sensitive organs.
What are some recommended techniques for using a massage gun effectively?
For effective use, start with a low-intensity setting and gently move the massage gun across the muscle groups.
Avoid excessive pressure and focus on sore or tight areas.
Vary the attachments for different muscle areas and use consistent, smooth movements for best results.
Avoid bony areas and joints.
Can a massage gun be used for both pre-workout warm-up and post-workout recovery?
Yes, a massage gun like the Hypervolt is effective for both pre-workout warm-ups and post-workout recovery.
It helps to loosen muscles, improve circulation, increase mobility before workouts, and aid in reducing muscle soreness to speed up recovery after exercise.

How much coffee does the AeroPress Original make?
The AeroPress Original can brew up to three shots of espresso style coffee.
If you prefer to brew your coffee by pushing all the water through the grounds, you can brew one 10 oz.
serving of coffee or cold brew.
What size filter do I use with the AeroPress Original?
You should use a Standard size filter with the AeroPress Original.
What kinds of coffee can the AeroPress Original make?
The AeroPress Original can make American style coffee, cold brew style coffee, or espresso style coffee for use in drinks like lattes and cappuccinos.
What are the maximum and minimum mug diameters the AeroPress Original fits?
The biggest mug you can press into with the AeroPress Original has a top inner diameter of 3 3/4 inches (95mm).
The smallest mug you can press into with the AeroPress Original has a top inner diameter of 2 5/8 inches (67mm).
Can I clean the AeroPress Original in the dishwasher?
You can in the top shelf, but a simple rinse is sufficient because the plunger wipes the chamber.
If your chamber ever gets sticky, wash it with vinegar.
We recommend occasionally removing the seal from the end of the plunger for a good washing inside and out with warm water and dish soap.
Where is AeroPress Original manufactured?
AeroPress Original is manufactured in the USA.
AeroPress was founded by inventor Alan Adler, who created the very first prototype in his garage in Palo Alto, California.
What grind size should I use?
For the best brewing experience, use a medium-fine grind size, shake to level the bed of coffee grounds before pouring in the water, and pour the water slowly.
How do I clean and store AeroPress coffee makers?
Storage and Care:
To maximize the food-grade silicone seal's life, always eject the used coffee right after brewing and store your AeroPress coffee maker with the seal pushed all the way through the chamber.
This keeps the seal free of compression for longer seal life.
There is no adhesive on the seal, so you can easily remove it and then replace it on the AeroPress plunger.
For day to day use, a simple rinse is sufficient because the plunger wipes the chamber clean as you brew.
What are the dimensions?
Plunger with Seal: 5.26" tall, 3.28" diameter; Chamber: 4.75" tall, 4.22" diameter (at widest part of the hexagon); Compressed Plunger + Chamber: 5.26" tall (height of the Plunger), 4.22" diameter (diameter of Chamber).
How much does the AeroPress Original weigh?
The weight of the AeroPress Original (including the chamber and plunger, the filter cap, the scoop, and the stirrer) is 7.75 ounces.
When camping, backpacking or traveling light, the parts of the AeroPress Original you would take along (the chamber, the plunger, the filter cap, and however many paper microfilters you thought you’d need) weigh 6.5 ounces.
You would leave the AeroPress scoop and stirrer at home, and use whatever spoon you were already bringing on your hike as a scoop and stirrer.
You should use a sturdy mug or carafe and should never press into a thin walled glass mug or carafe.
Inverted method:
The “inverted method” can cause the coffee maker to be less stable and prone to mishaps that expose the user to potential burns from hot liquid.
Be advised that we strongly discourage using the inverted method because it is less stable and therefore prone to tipping over and exposing the user to hot liquid.

What grind size should I use?

How do I clean and store AeroPress coffee makers?

For day to day use, a simple rinse is sufficient because the plunger wipes the chamber clean as you brew.

Safe for all exterior surfaces, including paint, wax, sealants, and ceramic coatings.
Features a fresh honeydew scent, making the car washing experience more enjoyable.
A high-tech car wash shampoo designed to produce thick, clinging foam that lifts dirt and grime off the surface.
It's pH-balanced formula is safe for all exterior surfaces, including paint, wax, sealants, and ceramic coatings.
The fresh honeydew scent makes the car washing experience more enjoyable, while the advanced formula ensures a scratch-free wash
Specifications
CWS\110\16, CWS\110\64, CWS\110
Applicable Finishes
Paintwork, Glass, Plastic, Rubber, Stainless Steel, Metal, Aluminum

For Bucket Wash

Wash surface with your car wash mitt and soapy solution.

For Foam Gun or Foam Cannon

Spray vehicle with thick wash foam to protect the paint against swirls and scratches.
Wash the surface with a wash mitt, then rinse with clean water and dry with a premium microfiber towel.
Shipping & Returns
Free Shipping on all orders over $75

Advanced Technology For No-Residue Rinsing

The chemistry.

Better than ever
The Hypervolt 2 has an improved ergonomic design, reduced weight, and three speeds of powerful percussion to help you get back to doing what you do, even better.
Whisper quiet
Don’t pause your favorite song or your favorite show.
Our patented QuietGlide® technology will have you saying “ahhh”, not “shhh”.
Recovery on demand
It's easy to find the warm-up and recovery plans that will help you feel and move better with step-by-step expert guidance through the Bluetooth® connected Hyperice App.
Everyday relaxation
The Hypervolt 2 delivers powerful, quiet percussion therapy that helps relieve everyday aches and muscle tension — whether you’re loosening up after a long day at your desk, recovering from a workout, or easing general stiffness so you can keep moving comfortably.
What is Hypervolt used for?
Hypervolt is used for various purposes, including sports recovery, pain management, stress reduction, and general wellness.
It's an ideal tool for athletes, fitness enthusiasts, or anyone looking to enhance their overall muscular health.
Can you bring your Hypervolt on a plane?
All Hypervolt massage guns are suitable for air travel as they are TSA friendly for carry-on.
It's important to store it in your carry-on luggage due to its lithium-ion battery, which cannot be taken in checked-in baggage.
How to connect your Hypervolt to Bluetooth®?
To connect the Hypervolt to Bluetooth®, ensure your Hypervolt is on.
Open the Hyperice App and follow the prompts to locate and select your device.
The Hyperice App will guide you through the pairing process, allowing you to control the Hypervolt and access customized routines.
How to charge your Hypervolt?
To charge the Hypervolt, connect the provided charger to the port on the device.
Plug the charger into an electrical outlet.
Charging is indicated by the lights on the device, and it's best to charge it until all lights are lit, signifying a full charge.
What does the light ring on the Hypervolt mean?
The light ring on the Hypervolt indicates the device's battery level and operational status.
If your light ring is green, it has optimal charge.
As your Hypervolt loses charge, it will change from yellow to red.
Once fully charged, your Hypervolt light ring will turn solid green.
What does the Bluetooth® connection for the Hypervolt do?
The Bluetooth® feature on the Hypervolt allows it to connect to the Hyperice App.
This connectivity offers personalized massage programs, control over the device's speed settings, and the ability to track and tailor your recovery and massage routines for optimal results.
You can also connect your Hyperice App to Apple Health, Whoop, Strava, and Garmin so that your recovery routines are tailored to your activity levels.
Are massage guns suitable for all body types and fitness levels?
Massage guns like the Hypervolt are generally suitable for various body types and fitness levels.
They are versatile tools designed for use by athletes, fitness enthusiasts, or anyone seeking muscle relief.
However, individuals with certain medical conditions or sensitivities should consult a healthcare professional before use.
What are some potential side effects of using a massage gun?
Proper use of massage guns typically results in minimal side effects.
However, excessive pressure or overuse can lead to muscle soreness or bruising.
It's important to use the device according to instructions and avoid using it on injured areas, bony areas, or near sensitive organs.
What are some recommended techniques for using a massage gun effectively?
For effective use, start with a low-intensity setting and gently move the massage gun across the muscle groups.
Avoid excessive pressure and focus on sore or tight areas.
Vary the attachments for different muscle areas and use consistent, smooth movements for best results.
Avoid bony areas and joints.
Can a massage gun be used for both pre-workout warm-up and post-workout recovery?
Yes, a massage gun like the Hypervolt is effective for both pre-workout warm-ups and post-workout recovery.
It helps to loosen muscles, improve circulation, increase mobility before workouts, and aid in reducing muscle soreness to speed up recovery after exercise.

handoff.page_text:
Original Gorilla Glue
Prepare and Dampen the Surfaces
If you’re using Original Gorilla Glue for the first time, or bonding a new type of material, we always recommend trying a test piece first.
To open a bottle larger than 2 ounces, cut the tip of the nozzle where it comes up to a point and starts to indent.
The cap is attached to the side of the nozzle.
Prepare your surfaces: All surfaces must be clean, dust free and tight fitting.
For shiny surfaces, such as metals, glass and some plastics, roughen up the material to give the glue something to bite into.
Damp It: Lightly dampen one surface with water.
We recommend using a damp cloth or spraying with water.
Do not saturate the surface.
For dense hardwoods, lightly dampen both surfaces prior to gluing.
Evenly Apply Gorilla Glue Onto the Dry Surface
Glue It: Carefully apply onto the dry surface.
Do not over apply.
We recommend wearing gloves or spreading the glue with a disposable brush.
In some instances, Gorilla Glue can be a skin sensitizer.

Picture yourself in the era of discoveries: after a long voyage of great deprivation, your ships have finally reached the coast of an uncharted island.
Its name shall be Catan!
But you are not the only discoverer.
Other fearless seafarers have also landed on the shores of Catan - the race to settle the island has begun!
About the Game
The women and men of your expedition build the first two settlements.
Fortunately, the yet uninhabited land is rich in natural resources.
You build roads and new settlements that eventually become cities.
Will you succeed in gaining supremacy on Catan?
Barter trade dominates the scene.
Some resources you have in abundance, other resources are scarce.
Ore for wool, brick for lumber - you trade according to what is needed for your current building projects.
Proceed strategically!
If you found your settlements in the right places and skillfully trade your resources, then the odds will be in your favor.
But your opponents are smart too.
First published in Germany in 1995 as Die Siedler von CATAN, then in English as The Settlers of CATAN in 1996, CATAN celebrates its 25th anniversary in 2020.
To begin the game, you build the game board using hexagonal terrain tiles.
Catan is born - a beautiful island with mountains, pastures, hills, fields, and forests, surrounded by the sea.
Each of you places two small houses on spaces where three terrain hexes meet.
They are your starting settlements.
And so it begins.
The starting player rolls two dice.
An “11!” Each terrain hex is marked with a number.
Each player who owns a settlement adjacent to a terrain hex marked with the number rolled receives a resource produced by this hex.
Hills produce brick, forests produce lumber, mountains produce ore, fields produce grain, and pastures produce wool.
You use these resources to expand across Catan: you build roads and new settlements or upgrade your existing settlements to cities.
For example, a road costs 1 brick and 1 lumber.
If you do not have the necessary resources, you can acquire them by trading with your opponents.
Each settlement is worth 1 victory point and each city is worth 2 victory points.
If you expand cleverly, you may be the first player to reach 10 victory points and thus win the game!
Playing Tips
I lost my first game of CATAN resoundingly.
Well, nobody had told me that with two dice the numbers 6 and 8 are rolled much more frequently than the numbers 2 and 12.
As you can imagine, I hardly received any resources for the settlement I had placed between terrain hexes marked with the numbers 2, 12, and 3.
I wrote down a couple of tips for you, so you can avoid having a similar experience.
I'll also give you a description of two variants I like to play.
Probability of Rolling Certain Numbers
If you roll 2 dice 36 times, the statistical distribution of the results is as follows:
2,12 - 1x each
3,11 - 2x each
4,10 - 3x each
This shows that the closer the numbers are to 7, the more frequently they are rolled.
Therefore, at least at the beginning of the game you should build settlements adjacent to terrain hexes marked with numbers close to 7.
Diversity of Terrain Hexes
You should make sure that your first two settlements are adjacent to all terrain types if possible.
This is the only way to receive as many different resources as possible, thus avoiding expensive trades with the bank.
Diversity of Numbers
A broad distribution of numbers is also beneficial.
For example, owning a settlement adjacent to two terrain hexes marked with a 6 and an 8, respectively, is more favorable than owning a settlement adjacent to two terrain hexes each of which is marked with an 8.
Harbors are of particular importance if you can expect a good production of a particular resource.
For example, if you have settlements adjacent to pasture hexes marked with good numbers, you should, as soon as possible, build a settlement on a coastal intersection next to the 2:1 wool harbor.
Then you can trade 2 wool for any 1 other resource of your choice.
If you trade cleverly, you improve your chances to win the game.
Trading with an opponent gives you and your opponent an advantage over the other players.
The less you trade, the more advantages you are giving away.
A little bit of complaining at the right time often works wonders.
The likelihood of receiving better trade offers increases, and the robber avoids your terrain hexes.
But don't overdo it!
The following variants are highly recommended:
"Three Victory Points" Rule
It is not allowed to place the robber on a terrain hex marked with a number if a player who has less than 3 victory points owns a settlement adjacent to this hex.
At the beginning of the game, when all players still have less than 3 victory points, the robber must thus be placed on a hex that doesn't have a settlement adjacent to it.
If this isn't possible, the robber stays in the desert.
Trade and Build in Any Order
The "first trade, then build" order is no longer observed.
The players may trade, then build, trade again, build again, etc.
If you play according to this variant, you also may immediately use a newly built harbor for maritime trade (trade with the bank at an improved rate).
Downloads for the Game
CATAN - The Game Rulebook.pdf")
CATAN - The Game 5-6 player rulebook
More Questions?
We have collected important questions and answers about the CATAN base game.
Just follow the link.

handoff.page_text:
Versatile tracking tag
POP is our most versatile, budget-friendly tracker with a replaceable battery.
Let it watch over your keys, backpack, luggage, and more.
POP finds your items with the help of the Apple Find My network on iPhones or Google’s Find Hub network on Android phones.
Call Your Phone and other free extra features are available in the Chipolo companion app.
30-day money back guarantee
Free shipping for orders over $70
Each Chipolo is individually packed
A gift they'll actually use...
and never lose.
How POP works
To locate your tracker on a map, use the Apple Find My app or the Find Hub app on Android.
To get free extra features and customize settings, use the Chipolo companion app.
Find by sound
Find on a map
A POP of color
Who says trackers should be boring?
After all, a little splash of color makes finding lost things easier.
Easily heard, easily found
With a ring loud enough to cut through couch cushions and closed doors, POP makes lost items easy to hear.
Bluetooth range
Up to 120 dB
Finds phone, too
Double-press your POP to call your phone and find it instantly.
Yes, even if it’s set to silent and hiding under a pile of pillows.
Easy to attach
Thanks to its built-in keyhole, POP attaches straight to your keyring.
No custom cases or hidden costs, just pure peace of mind right out of the box.
Replaceable battery
POP runs on a Duracell battery with a bitter coating that keeps curious pets and kids safe.
When it runs low, you can pop in a new one in no time.
Battery type
Up to 1 year
Battery life
Built for life
POP is built to keep up with you.
It’s resistant to dust and water splashes, so a bit of rain or dirt won’t hurt it.
Just don't take it swimming, it'll drown.
Resistant to dust and water splashes
Free extra features in the Chipolo app
Go beyond the basics and set advanced finding features in the free Chipolo companion app.
Call Your Phone
Double-press your Chipolo to call your phone and find it in seconds.
Out of Range Alerts
Get a reminder when you leave things behind.
Change Ringtone
Set a different ringtone for each Chipolo.
Choosing Chipolo means choosing a product designed with care and built right in the heart of Europe.
Company Values
Made in Europe
Chipolo trackers are made at our European HQ using at least 50% recycled plastic in their shells.
Extra features
The free Chipolo companion app unlocks phone finding and more extra features.
How many Chipolos can I add to Apple Find My, Find Hub on Android, and the Chipolo app?
You can add up to 32 items to Apple Find My, including shared items and accessories, like Chipolo.
Google's Find My Device doesn't have a publicly stated limit for the number of Bluetooth devices you can add, but we have successfully tested it with more than 32 Chipolos added.
For the Chipolo app, we recommend adding a maximum of 6 Chipolos if you use an Android device and a maximum of 9 Chipolos if you use an iPhone.
We suggest you add only those Chipolos where you need the extra features (like Call Your Phone) the most.
To switch between networks, you can reset the tracker by removing it from the current app (and the Chipolo app, too) and then reconnect it on another device.
Using both networks simultaneously isn’t possible due to Apple and Google policies and inherent incompatibility between Apple Find My and Find Hub.
Are Chipolos packed separately?
Each Chipolo is packed in its own box and can be used or gifted separately and by different people.
What's your return and refund policy?
You can return your Chipolos for a full refund to your original payment method within 30 days of receiving your order.
The order must be returned in good condition and must be packed in the original boxes you received your Chipolos in.
Chipolo does not cover any return shipping fees and reserves the right to decline refunds that are returned past the 30-day return period.

Protected from dust and water splashes (IP55)
Optimal Bluetooth range

Sharing feature
Share your Chipolo with your loved ones
Chipolo POP tech specs
Loudness: ∼ 120 dB
Bluetooth range: 90 m (300 ft)
Thickness: 6,6 mm (0.26 in)
Size:: 38,8 mm (1.53 in)
Water resistance: IP55
Protected from dust and water splashes.
Battery life: Up to 1 year
Replaceable battery: CR2032
A common, easily replaceable coin battery is used.
We use and recommend Duracell batteries with bitter coating to deter ingestion, especially by children and animals.
iOS: Works with the Apple Find My app.
Your device must be running iOS 14.5 or later.
To use the Apple Find My app to locate this item, the latest version of iOS, iPadOS, or macOS is recommended.
The Find Items app on Apple Watch requires the latest version of watchOS.
Android: Works with the Find Hub app on Android phones or tablets running Android 9+ with Google Play Services installed, and in certain countries for age-eligible users.
The Find Hub network requires location services and Bluetooth to be turned on, and cell service or an internet connection.
Chipolo companion app: Extra finding features and settings are available in the free Chipolo app on both iPhones and Android devices.
The Chipolo app is supported on Android 12 or later versions and iOS 17 or later versions.
\ Compatible with one network at a time (either Apple Find My or Find Hub on Android).
Meet Chipolo POP - a colorful tracking tag designed to help you live your life to the fullest.
It helps you locate your keys, wallet, backpack, and more with a loud ring or with the help of the Apple Find My or Google's Find My Device network.

Legion Pulse Ingredients (15.1 grams per serving)
Caffeine (350 milligrams per serving)
Caffeine is a naturally occurring substance found in many plants native to Africa, East Asia, and South America, including various kinds of tea, cocoa, and coffee.
Caffeine’s primary effects in the body are to stimulate the central nervous system and block the activity of another chemical—adenosine—that causes tiredness.
Research shows that supplementation with caffeine .
Boosts mood and energy levels 10
Improves focus, drive, and wakefulness 11–13 12 13
Increases metabolic rate 14
Enhances strength and power 15–19 16 17 18 19
Boosts endurance 20–22 21 22
Improves anaerobic performance 23–27 24 25 26 27
The clinically effective dose of caffeine for enhancing energy, focus, and performance is between 1 and 6 milligrams per kilogram of body weight.
L-Theanine (350 milligrams per serving)
L-theanine is an amino acid found primarily in tea that helps balance the levels of two chemicals in the brain—glutamate and GABA—that transmit nerve impulses and affect mood, cognitive performance, and more.
Research shows that supplementation with L-theanine .
Reduces the effects of mental stress 31
Promotes relaxation 32
Improves mood, memory performance, and attention (when paired with caffeine) 33–36 34 35 36
Increases the production of nitric oxide (which improves blood flow) 37
The clinically effective dose of L-theanine when combined with caffeine is between a ratio of 1:1 and 2:1 theanine to caffeine.
Citrulline Malate (8 grams per serving)
Citrulline malate is the amino acid L-citrulline bound with malic acid, a substance found in many fruits that is involved in the creation of cellular energy.
L-citrulline turns into another amino acid in the body known as L-arginine, which increases the production of a gas known as nitric oxide that widens blood vessels and improves blood flow.
This is why research shows that supplementation with citrulline malate .
Improves muscle endurance 40–42 41 42
Relieves muscle soreness 43
Improves aerobic performance 44,45 45
The clinically effective dose of citrulline malate is between 4 and 10 grams.
Beta-Alanine (3.6 grams per serving)
Beta-alanine is a naturally occurring amino acid that regulates the amount of the molecule carnosine that can be stored in the muscles.
Carnosine reduces muscle acidity, which increases the amount of work that muscles can do before they become fatigued.
This is why research shows that supplementation with beta-alanine .
Reduces exercise-induced fatigue 48–51 49 50 51
Improves anaerobic exercise capacity 52–56 53 54 55 56
Increases potential workload, which can lead to an increase in lean mass 57,58 58
Reduces feelings of fatigue during exercise 59–61 60 61
The clinically effective dose of beta-alanine is between 2.6 and 6.4 grams.
We chose to include 3.6 grams of beta-alanine per serving because it provides significant performance benefits while also minimizing the common and harmless side effect of a mild prickling, itching, or tingling of the skin.
Alpha-GPC (300 milligrams per serving)
Alpha-glycerophosphocholine (also known as alpha-GPC and glycerophosphocholine) is a compound that contains two molecules known as choline and glycerophosphate.
Choline is a nutrient that’s vital for brain health and function, and glycerophosphate is a substance that helps transport choline to the brain.
When ingested, alpha-GPC increases the activity of a chemical in the brain known as acetylcholine, which is used by nerves to communicate with each other, and provides the brain with glycerophosphate, which can improve its health and function.
This is why research shows that supplementation with alpha-GPC .
Increases power output 63
Mitigates cognitive decline as we age 64
Increases growth hormone levels 65
The clinically effective dose of alpha-GPC is between 150 and 1,200 milligrams, with 250 to 500 milligrams sufficient for cognitive benefits.
We chose to include 300 milligrams of alpha-GPC (50%) per serving because it’s enough to provide some benefit without eating up too much budget that we’d rather spend on other ingredients.
Betaine (2.5 grams per serving)
Betaine (also known as trimethylglycine) is an amino acid found in various foods like beets (hence the name), spinach, and quinoa.
Betaine’s rich in a special molecule known as a methyl group, which is a vital component of many physiological functions, including DNA production, fat metabolism, cellular energy production, and more.
Betaine’s also an osmolyte, which is a substance that helps balance fluid levels inside and outside cells.
These two properties are beneficial during times of physical stress, and this is why studies show that betaine boosts muscle endurance and increases strength.
The clinically effective dose of betaine is between 1.25 and 2.5 grams.

100% Money-Back Guarantee
If you don't absolutely love Pulse, you get a prompt and courteous refund.
No forms or returns necessary.
What does Pulse add beyond a cup of coffee?
Pulse adds ingredients that support strength and muscular endurance to the energy and focus you get from caffeine.
A full two-scoop serving provides:
8 grams of citrulline malate to improve muscle endurance and relieve post-workout soreness.
2.5 grams of betaine to increase strength.
3.6 grams of beta-alanine to help reduce fatigue and increase the amount of work your muscles can do.
300 mg of alpha-GPC (50%) to supply choline, which your brain uses to make acetylcholine—a chemical involved in focus and memory.
You get these ingredients together in one drink, with the dose of every active ingredient clearly listed on the label.
It’s a convenient way to give your workouts additional support and see exactly what you’re getting.
Should I take one scoop or two?
Start with one scoop to see how you respond.
You can choose your serving size based on your caffeine tolerance and the amount of workout support you want:
One scoop: 175 mg of caffeine, plus half the amount of every other active ingredient.
Two scoops: 350 mg of caffeine and the full ingredient amounts listed on the label.
If you prefer the boost from one scoop, you can keep using that amount.
If you tolerate it well and want the full serving, you can try two scoops at a later workout.
Take no more than two scoops per day, and factor in caffeine from coffee, tea, and other sources.
For most healthy adults, up to 400 mg of caffeine per day is generally considered safe, but some people experience jitters or sleep problems at lower amounts.
Pulse undergoes independent lab testing to verify its active ingredient amounts and check for heavy metals and harmful microbes.
That includes measuring ingredients such as caffeine, citrulline malate, beta-alanine, and betaine against the amounts listed on the label.
A 20-serving tub contains approximately 40 scoops:
Two scoops per workout (a full serving): about 20 workouts.
One scoop per workout (a half serving): about 40 workouts.
If you use Pulse four times per week, that’s about five weeks at two scoops or ten weeks at one scoop.
Do you offer Pulse samples or a money-back guarantee?
We don’t currently offer Pulse samples.
Your first purchase of Pulse from us is covered by our 365-day money-back guarantee—even after you open the tub and try it.
Try it in your usual workout routine and see what you think.
If you don’t enjoy the flavor, don’t like how it makes you feel, or are simply unhappy with it, let us know within 365 days of purchase and we’ll refund you in full.
For a single-tub purchase, you won’t need to send it back.
If your refund involves multiple supplements, we may ask you to return them, and we’ll cover the return shipping.
What should I expect to feel?
Pulse is designed to boost energy and focus, help increase strength, and improve muscular endurance so you can do more work before fatigue sets in.
How strong the energy boost feels depends on your serving size and caffeine sensitivity.
You may also notice tingling or prickling, often in your face or hands.
Beta-alanine can cause this temporary, harmless sensation.
Some people feel it more than others, and more tingling doesn’t mean more benefit.
Beta-alanine’s performance benefits build with consistent use over several weeks.
If that gives you the boost you want, you can stick with it.
Which flavor should I choose?
Start with the flavors you already enjoy in drinks or candy.
A few places to begin:
Fruit Punch for a familiar fruit drink flavor.
Pink Lemonade if you enjoy citrus.
Sour Candy if you like sour sweets.
If your drink tastes too sweet or strong, add more water.
You’ll still get the same amount of caffeine and other active ingredients when you finish the drink.
And if you don’t like it, your first purchase of Pulse from us is covered by our 365-day satisfaction guarantee.
What sweeteners and other ingredients are in Pulse?
Pulse is naturally sweetened and flavored, with no artificial sweeteners, artificial flavors, or synthetic food dyes.
We use natural sweeteners such as stevia, along with flavoring and coloring derived from fruits and other foods, to make Pulse enjoyable to drink.
Other ingredients vary by flavor.
For example, Red Gummy Fish and Strawberry Blast contain a milk-derived creamer to enhance their taste and texture.
Select the flavor you’re considering and check its label on this page to see the complete ingredient list before ordering.
How long before my workout should I take Pulse?
Mix Pulse with water and drink it 15–30 minutes before your workout.
If you’re trying it for the first time, start with one scoop to see how you respond.
Can I use Pulse only on workout days?
You can use Pulse before your workouts and skip it on rest days.
Several ingredients can provide benefits from a single serving:
Caffeine boosts energy, strength, and endurance.
L-theanine paired with caffeine improves focus.
Citrulline malate can help improve muscle endurance and relieve post-workout soreness.
Some benefits depend on consistent use.
Beta-alanine’s ability to help your muscles resist fatigue builds with daily use over several weeks.
Betaine’s strength benefits have also generally been studied with daily supplementation.
Is Pulse vegan-friendly?
Most Pulse flavors are vegan-friendly.
Red Gummy Fish and Strawberry Blast contain a milk-derived creamer, so those flavors aren’t suitable for a vegan diet.
Check the ingredient list on your chosen flavor’s label before ordering.
Is Pulse gluten-free?
Pulse is gluten-free.
What does the Prop 65 warning on the labels mean?
We include this warning to comply with California’s Proposition 65 law, which requires businesses to warn about certain exposures to substances associated with cancer or reproductive harm.
A Proposition 65 warning is not a finding that a product is unsafe.
Some listed substances, including certain heavy metals, occur in the environment and can be present in everyday foods and supplements.
We independently test our supplements for heavy metals and other contaminants.
You can view our published lab results to see the measurements and purity checks for yourself.
Pulse is lab-tested for purity and accuracy and independently certified by Labdoor™ to contain no heavy metals, microbes, allergens, or other contaminants or banned substances.

Does Force of Nature Cleaner have a scent?
Force of Nature has a very light, clean swimming-pool-like scent that’s naturally created when salt, water & vinegar are electrolyzed in the appliance.

What is the active ingredient in Force of Nature Cleaner?
The active disinfecting ingredient in Force of Nature Cleaner is hypochlorous acid (HOCl), a powerful antimicrobial that’s tough on germs but gentle enough to be used around kids and pets when used as directed.
Hypochlorous acid is the same compound your immune system makes to fight infections.

What is the science behind Force of Nature Cleaner?
The Force of Nature appliance uses an electrical current to transform salt, water, and vinegar into two new ingredients:
hypochlorous acid (the disinfectant) and sodium hydroxide (the cleaner).
